education.summary: His campaign lists "strong, fairly-funded public schools" among his legislative priorities, saying strong public schools are paramount to a vibrant community and a strong economy.
education.short: Lists strong, fairly-funded public schools as a priority.

healthcare.summary: His campaign lists "the availability of affordable, high-quality healthcare" among his priorities, saying healthcare should be available and affordable for all Pennsylvanians.
healthcare.short: Lists affordable, high-quality healthcare as a priority.

abortion.summary: His campaign lists "access to reproductive healthcare, including abortion, as a protected right" among his priorities.
abortion.short: Supports reproductive healthcare, including abortion, as a protected right.

energy.summary: His campaign lists "investment in infrastructure to improve our communities and to mitigate the impact of extreme weather" among his priorities.
energy.short: Supports infrastructure investment to mitigate extreme weather impacts.

guns.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 1065 (2025), which would prohibit the sale of privately made firearms without serial numbers, described in its memo as banning ghost guns; he is one of roughly 60 co-sponsors, with Rep. Morgan Cephas as prime sponsor.
guns.short: Co-sponsored 2025 bill to ban ghost guns.
